# discord_channel_role_permissions (Data Source)

Reads the permissions a role grants together with `@everyone` in a channel, as Discord computes them, applying the channel's overwrites for both. Other roles and member-specific overwrites are not included. Threads use their parent channel's overwrites. The bot needs `VIEW_CHANNEL` in the channel, and `CONNECT` as well in voice and stage channels. See [Get Channel Role Permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/resources/channel#get-channel-role-permissions).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "discord_role" "moderators" {
  server_id = var.server_id
  name      = "Moderators"
}

# What the role grants in a channel, after the channel's overwrites for
# @everyone and the role. implicit = false keeps the permissions Discord
# would otherwise mask because the role cannot view the channel.
data "discord_channel_role_permissions" "moderators_staff" {
  channel_id = var.staff_channel_id
  role_id    = data.discord_role.moderators.id
  implicit   = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel or thread.
- `role_id` (String) ID of the role.

### Optional

- `implicit` (Boolean) Whether Discord masks the permissions that a missing `VIEW_CHANNEL`, or a missing `CONNECT` in a voice or stage channel, makes unusable (see [implicit permissions](https://docs.discord.com/developers/topics/permissions#implicit-permissions)). Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `permission_names` (Set of String) Names of the permission flags set in `permissions`, such as `VIEW_CHANNEL`. Flags this provider does not know are omitted.
- `permissions` (String) The computed permissions as a decimal bitfield string.
